zh: 上下文计价的字符类别系数对 DeepSeek 分词器重新拟合（词长表与数字锚点保持不变），详情栏分项更贴近实际占用；流式增长的低估单独成层，基准准确度与动画手感各自独立可调
en: Refit the context estimator's character-class rates to the DeepSeek tokenizer (word-length table and digit anchors preserved) for a closer detail-panel split; the streaming growth under-estimate becomes its own layer, so base accuracy and animation feel tune independently
